authored.contrast_ar: I was tired, but I continued تباين متصل؛ I was tired. However, I continued انتقال رسمي.
authored.contrast_en: But coordinates a contrast; however needs different punctuation between independent clauses.

authored.explanation_ar: تربط however جملتين مستقلتين في سياق أهدأ أو أكثر رسمية؛ يمكن أن تأتي بعد فاصلة منقوطة ولا نربط جملتين مستقلتين بفاصلة وحدها قبلها. عند وصل جملتين مستقلتين نضع نقطة أو فاصلة منقوطة قبل however، لا فاصلة وحدها في الكتابة القياسية المدروسة.
authored.explanation_en: Use however to introduce contrast across sentences, often after a period or semicolon. When linking independent clauses, put a full stop or semicolon before however rather than a comma alone.
authored.contrast_ar: The room is small, but useful جملة واحدة؛ The room is small. However, it works well جملتان.
authored.contrast_en: Use a full stop or semicolon before however when linking independent clauses; a comma alone creates a comma splice in the formal standard taught here.
